text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's time for Tracen Academy's yearly summer camp. Symboli Rudolf stays behind until the last minute conducting final checks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite the time crunch, she's totally unhurried, and she makes it in perfect time for the summer camp's official opening with a little help from Maruzensky.
